subject: world_language
concept: Summarizing a longer text or spoken passage accurately in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B2 'summarize information' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student selects the key points from a longer passage using a highlighting/sorting activity
exercise.abstract: Student writes an accurate summary of a longer target-language passage, capturing its key points

assessment.mastery_threshold: summary captures the main points without significant omissions or inaccuracies
misconception_flags: summary focuses on a minor detail while missing the passage's actual main points

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
